description: Compute late-payment damages (خسارت تأخیر تأدیه, article 522 of the Civil Procedure Code) on a debt in rial between the month it fell due and the month it is paid, from the Central Bank's monthly price index. Use it for a money debt, a cheque or a judgment sum; a mehrieh is valued with calculate_mehrieh instead. A month whose index is not published yet uses the latest published one, and the result says so. Returns the damages, their breakdown and the index figures used with their dates. Amounts in rial; dates in the Jalali calendar.

due_year.description: Jalali year the debt fell due or was demanded.

payment_month.description: Jalali month of payment, 1 for فروردین.

payment_year.description: Jalali year of payment; this year when they do not say.
